task: Audit Java-generated Executor runtime against documented configuration behavior.
observation: The Java Executor builder accepted and retained affinity and priority settings, but generated worker startup never read them. The C++ runtime and Phase 20 contract apply these as best-effort hints and warn on unsupported or refused requests.
impact: Moss programs could configure hints without the generated runtime making any attempt to honor them, so accepted configuration silently had no effect in Java-generated programs.

resolution.summary: The generated runtime now applies affinity and priority on Linux worker startup and warns on refusal or unsupported platforms; generated Rust still needs frozen-candidate compilation and execution.
